phase: Phase 2: Green — the updates and the lock file
summary: Phase 2 fails acceptance at 116ab89 on two prerequisite blockers. The code and lock content pass every re-check. The audit gate exits 0 with 0 critical, 0 high, and 5 moderate. The pins match the record. The Green commits touch only the two package files. No fixture file changed. The adversarial result is missing. Review A and Review B bind to older HEADs. Adversarial testing must run first. It needs no new commit.
blocking_findings: F2 [Blocker] phase-acceptance: The adversarial testing result is missing. test-strategy.md:196 assigns adversarial testing as `yes, bounded`. `measure/runs/deps_refresh/` holds no `adversarial-*` file. The role contract needs this result before acceptance. The strategy names three probes. Probe 1: a fixed high advisory resolves outside its vulnerable range. Probe 2: a synthetic identity added to a copy of the after file makes `TSC_AFTER` fail. Probe 3: a residual row without its reason makes `RESIDUAL_GATE` fail. Probe 1 holds at HEAD, because this acceptance checked all six versions. Probes 2 and 3 did not run. Fix: run `measure-adversarial-testing` on the final HEAD. It writes only `measure/runs/`, so HEAD does not move. Rationale: the strategy marks the role as required, so the absence blocks acceptance.

F3 [Blocker] phase-acceptance: Review A and Review B do not target the audited HEAD. Review A passed at `bf96724`. Review B passed at `8437779`. The audited HEAD is `116ab89`. The commits `2be181e`, `8437779`, `9f4c6ca`, `6fdea72`, and `116ab89` change `plan.md` and `spec.md`. These files are not test files and not `measure/runs/`, so the contract exception does not apply. `git diff --name-only fc9ec99 HEAD -- harness/` prints nothing, so the reviewed lock content is unchanged. Fix: run bounded Review A and Review B on the final HEAD. These runs write only `measure/runs/`, so HEAD does not move. Rationale: the role contract needs every prerequisite result on the accepted HEAD.
nonblocking_findings: F8 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The deferral reasons for typescript 7.0.2 and vitest 5.1.1 (plan.md:144-151) say `The task 3.1 gates have not run`. The gates have run since then, on typescript 5.9.3 and vitest 4.1.10. Neither major was tried. Spec D3 defers a major when the gates fail with it. Fix: state the real reason for each deferral in task 2.1 (not tried; cohort comparability for vitest).

Answer to the orchestrator question: test-strategy.md:196 requires adversarial testing, so it must run first for Phase 2 and Phase 3. It does not block Phase 1. Do the work in this order. First, make one plan commit for the Phase 1 and Phase 3 findings (F1, F4, and the nonblocking items). Second, run bounded adversarial testing, Review A, and Review B on that HEAD. These audits write only measure/runs/, so they do not move HEAD. Third, run Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 acceptance again on that HEAD. The user can accept Review A and Review B at bf96724 and 8437779 for a docs-only delta, because harness/ is identical since fc9ec99. Record that deviation in the next brief. Acceptance then treats F3 as met.
